planB.title: If your flight home is cancelled.

steps.title: Rebook while you queue.
steps.text: Get in line at the airline desk and open the airline app at the same time. Take whichever gets you a new flight first.

steps.title: Ask for your options by name.
steps.text: Your flight leaves the UK, so UK261 rules apply: the airline has to offer a refund or a replacement flight, plus food and a hotel if you're stuck overnight.

steps.title: Keep the proof.
steps.text: Screenshot the cancellation message and keep every receipt for food and transport.

steps.title: Tell your program early.
steps.text: Message your study abroad coordinator before class starts. One line is enough: flight cancelled, rebooked for this time, screenshot attached.

steps.title: One person updates the group.
steps.text: Put the new times on the board so the group chat doesn't end up with three versions of the plan.

lastTripFix: Platforms change on the station board, not on your ticket. On travel days one person is the board-checker: look 15 minutes before departure and again at 5.

essentials.v: 999 or 112 for police, fire and ambulance.
US citizens need an approved UK ETA before they fly. Apply on the UK ETA app, and allow a few days.
Tap a contactless card or phone in and out on the Tube, buses and trains from Gatwick. Fares cap daily. Everyone needs their own card or phone, and the same one in and out.
Pounds sterling (GBP). Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere.
Type G, 230V. Bring a UK adapter.
